language_semantics_records.plain_language_meaning: Object properties have attributes beyond their value.
language_semantics_records.precise_behavior: Descriptors can be data or accessor descriptors and control writable, enumerable, configurable, get, and set behavior. Reflection/copying APIs may not preserve descriptors by default.
language_semantics_records.why_it_matters: Descriptors explain read-only properties, getters/setters, enumeration differences, and clone/refactor surprises.
common_misuse: Copying with spread and expecting descriptors preserved
Assigning to read-only/accessor property without checking strict mode behavior
Ignoring getter side effects during serialization/copy
tests_or_checks: Use Reflect.ownKeys plus descriptors for faithful clone
safe_refactor_notes: Preserve descriptors when exact object behavior matters
Avoid descriptor tricks in ordinary data objects

language_semantics_records.plain_language_meaning: Proxy can intercept fundamental object operations; Reflect exposes corresponding operation functions.
language_semantics_records.precise_behavior: A Proxy wraps a target with traps such as get, set, has, ownKeys, apply, and construct. Traps must respect invariants. Reflect methods perform default-like operations and are useful inside traps.
language_semantics_records.why_it_matters: Proxy can solve boundary problems but makes property access, debugging, and refactoring opaque.
common_misuse: Using Proxy for ordinary property defaults where plain functions suffice
Hiding side effects in get traps
safe_refactor_notes: Avoid introducing Proxy without clear boundary benefit
Document traps and add regression tests before changes

language_semantics_records.plain_language_meaning: Well-known symbols let objects participate in language protocols.
language_semantics_records.precise_behavior: Symbol.iterator, Symbol.asyncIterator, Symbol.toPrimitive, Symbol.toStringTag, Symbol.hasInstance and others customize iteration, conversion, string tags, instanceof, and related behavior.
language_semantics_records.why_it_matters: These hooks make ordinary syntax call custom code and therefore matter in debugging and review.
common_misuse: Adding hooks that surprise users of operators
tests_or_checks: Test ordinary syntax that triggers hooks
safe_refactor_notes: Prefer explicit methods unless language integration is necessary
